decisions.reason: The flat clause imposed an affine-line restriction although massive and null worldlines are kinematic C² causal curves. Replaced it by arbitrary C² curves into A with origin-independent displacement derivative; no geodesic restriction remains. For an orthonormal e0,e1, x(s)=o+s e0+s²e1 is timelike on |s|<1/2 and is now admitted. Curved definitions, cones, observers and units are unchanged.

False positive: the stipulated background is the object of def-rpm-spacetime-observer-and-worldline, which explicitly adopts def-gr-smooth-lorentzian-objects. Clause (c) of that exact definition assumes AC_omega for the smooth tangent-bundle structure, and its scope clause records no further choice. This inherited hypothesis supplies the AC_omega premise of the cited Levi-Civita theorem. Smooth coordinate ODE, orthogonal-force norm preservation, future-cone continuity, parameter dependence and uniqueness gluing establish the stated local/maximal result without arbitrary family choice.

Confirmed missing explicit coordinate/parameter units in this physics-domain example. Specified SI length coordinates theta, xi, periods L, ell and affine parameter s in metres, dimensionless metric components and normalized dgamma/ds, and proper time ds/c in seconds. Local constant-metric coordinate lines have zero acceleration; quotient periodicity gives the closed timelike geodesic, while endpoint coordinate limits 0 and ell prohibit extending the slab geodesic. No measured claim or completeness assumption is introduced.

The smooth pullback definition cited in F10 did not define derivatives for the stated C² variations. Added Proof 1.1: define the component derivative for C¹ fields along C¹ curves, prove chart independence by matching values and first derivatives with smooth data, and derive metric pairing from the component compatibility identity. Then C² H supplies commuting mixed derivatives, continuous integrands and integration by parts; supported coordinate variations prove necessity, including endpoints. The Statement and its reparametrization class remain unchanged.

The flat reunion setup left the metric identification implicit. Made its intended background explicit: M=A with the affine smooth structure, g induced by eta and constant future field N=e0, so the named orthonormal inertial chart has diag(-1,1,1,1). The lab density is 1; both traveler legs have density sqrt(1-v²/c²)>0; piecewise proper-time additivity gives the stated readings. The instantaneous turn remains an idealized corner, not an empirical measurement.

F11 originally supplied only a smooth pullback derivative for the C² variation class. It now explicitly uses the coordinate derivative for C¹ fields and cites the completed coordinate-independence and metric-pairing proof in lem-rpm-length-action-first-variation, Proof 1.1. C² variations have C¹ tangent fields, justifying mixed derivatives and integration by parts in step 1.2. Independent positive-einbein bumps yield the constraint; massive elimination, the separately nonzero null branch and smooth reparametrization density are unchanged.

The definition named a future normalized tangent without displaying the normalization of the adopted trajectory. Specified an admissible C² future timelike curve on an interval, T=dx/ds and U=cT/sqrt(-g(T,T)); the already adopted positive proper-time density gives U=dx/dtau by chain rule and g(U,U)=-c² by bilinearity. This is an explicit formulation repair, preserving arbitrary parameters and open or finite segments. Null momentum, projections, energy and units are unchanged.

False positive: although the pairing supplier Statement is phrased for smooth sections, its Proof 1.1 explicitly states that the component formula and pairing calculation hold for C¹ fields along a C¹ curve; Proof 2.1 expands the metric components and uses compatibility, which indeed requires only these first derivatives. Applying that established calculation to C¹ U yields g(U,D_tau U)=0, and the product rule gives -c² dm/dtau. For the digest concern, the exact F3 supplier clause 1 covers every nonzero future causal vector, including null P, and licenses the positive null energy used in step 1.2. The mass-shell decomposition and flat inertial work deduction also have their stated hypotheses. No carrier edit is needed.
